mapper.update: UPDATE loan_product_catalog SET active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE loan_type = #{loanType} AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_product_catalog ( source_type, source_product_key, source_finance_code, source_product_code, source_product_subtype, disclosure_month, product_name, loan_type, min_rate, max_rate, max_limit_amount, max_period_months, target_description, active, institution_name, institution_id, join_way, disclosure_start_date, disclosure_end_date, source_submitted_at, source_url, collected_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{sourceProductKey}, #{sourceFinanceCode}, #{sourceProductCode}, COALESCE(#{sourceProductSubtype}, ''), #{disclosureMonth}, #{productName}, #{loanType}, #{minRate}, #{maxRate}, #{maxLimitAmount}, #{maxPeriodMonths}, #{targetDescription}, COALESCE(#{active}, TRUE), #{institutionName}, #{institutionId}, #{joinWay}, #{disclosureStartDate}, #{disclosureEndDate}, #{sourceSubmittedAt}, #{sourceUrl}, COALESCE(#{collectedAt}, NOW()) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_finance_code = VALUES(source_finance_code), source_product_code = VALUES(source_product_code), disclosure_month = VALUES(disclosure_month), product_name = VALUES(product_name), loan_type = VALUES(loan_type), min_rate = VALUES(min_rate), max_rate = VALUES(max_rate), max_limit_amount = VALUES(max_limit_amount), max_period_months = VALUES(max_period_months), target_description = VALUES(target_description), active = VALUES(active), institution_name = VALUES(institution_name), institution_id = VALUES(institution_id), join_way = VALUES(join_way), disclosure_start_date = VALUES(disclosure_start_date), disclosure_end_date = VALUES(disclosure_end_date), source_submitted_at = VALUES(source_submitted_at), source_url = VALUES(source_url), collected_at = VALUES(collected_at), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO housing_loan_product_detail ( catalog_product_id, loan_incidental_expense, early_repayment_fee_text, delinquency_rate_text, loan_limit_text ) VALUES ( #{catalogProductId}, #{detail.incidentalExpense}, #{detail.earlyRepaymentFee}, #{detail.delinquencyRate}, #{detail.loanLimit} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE loan_incidental_expense = VALUES(loan_incidental_expense), early_repayment_fee_text = VALUES(early_repayment_fee_text), delinquency_rate_text = VALUES(delinquency_rate_text), loan_limit_text = VALUES(loan_limit_text), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO housing_loan_product_option ( catalog_product_id, collateral_type_code, collateral_type_name, repayment_type_code, repayment_type_name, rate_type_code, rate_type_name, min_rate, max_rate, average_rate ) VALUES ( #{catalogProductId}, COALESCE(#{option.collateralTypeCode}, ''), #{option.collateralTypeName}, #{option.repaymentTypeCode}, #{option.repaymentTypeName}, #{option.rateTypeCode}, #{option.rateTypeName}, #{option.minRate}, #{option.maxRate}, #{option.averageRate} )

INSERT INTO credit_loan_product_detail ( catalog_product_id, credit_bureau_name, credit_product_type_code, credit_product_type_name ) VALUES ( #{catalogProductId}, #{detail.creditBureauName}, #{detail.productTypeCode}, #{detail.productTypeName} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE credit_bureau_name = VALUES(credit_bureau_name), credit_product_type_code = VALUES(credit_product_type_code), credit_product_type_name = VALUES(credit_product_type_name), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO credit_loan_rate_option ( catalog_product_id, rate_category_code, rate_category_name, rate_over_900, rate_801_900, rate_701_800, rate_601_700, rate_501_600, rate_401_500, rate_301_400, rate_300_or_below, average_rate ) VALUES ( #{catalogProductId}, #{option.categoryCode}, #{option.categoryName}, #{option.over900}, #{option.from801To900}, #{option.from701To800}, #{option.from601To700}, #{option.from501To600}, #{option.from401To500}, #{option.from301To400}, #{option.belowOrEqual300}, #{option.averageRate} )
mapper.select: SELECT catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, source_type AS sourceType, source_product_key AS sourceProductKey, source_finance_code AS sourceFinanceCode, source_product_code AS sourceProductCode, source_product_subtype AS sourceProductSubtype, disclosure_month AS disclosureMonth, product_name AS productName, loan_type AS loanType, min_rate AS minRate, max_rate AS maxRate, max_limit_amount AS maxLimitAmount, max_period_months AS maxPeriodMonths, target_description AS targetDescription, active, institution_name AS institutionName, institution_id AS institutionId, join_way AS joinWay, disclosure_start_date AS disclosureStartDate, disclosure_end_date AS disclosureEndDate, source_submitted_at AS sourceSubmittedAt, source_url AS sourceUrl, collected_at AS collectedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM loan_product_catalog WHERE catalog_product_id = #{catalogProductId}

SELECT catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, loan_incidental_expense AS loanIncidentalExpense, early_repayment_fee_text AS earlyRepaymentFeeText, delinquency_rate_text AS delinquencyRateText, loan_limit_text AS loanLimitText, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM housing_loan_product_detail WHERE catalog_product_id = #{catalogProductId}

SELECT housing_loan_product_option_id AS housingLoanProductOptionId, catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, collateral_type_code AS collateralTypeCode, collateral_type_name AS collateralTypeName, repayment_type_code AS repaymentTypeCode, repayment_type_name AS repaymentTypeName, rate_type_code AS rateTypeCode, rate_type_name AS rateTypeName, min_rate AS minRate, max_rate AS maxRate, average_rate AS averageRate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM housing_loan_product_option WHERE catalog_product_id = #{catalogProductId} ORDER BY collateral_type_code, repayment_type_code, rate_type_code, housing_loan_product_option_id

SELECT catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, credit_bureau_name AS creditBureauName, credit_product_type_code AS creditProductTypeCode, credit_product_type_name AS creditProductTypeName, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM credit_loan_product_detail WHERE catalog_product_id = #{catalogProductId}

SELECT credit_loan_rate_option_id AS creditLoanRateOptionId, catalog_product_id AS catalogProductId, rate_category_code AS rateCategoryCode, rate_category_name AS rateCategoryName, rate_over_900 AS rateOver900, rate_801_900 AS rate801To900, rate_701_800 AS rate701To800, rate_601_700 AS rate601To700, rate_501_600 AS rate501To600, rate_401_500 AS rate401To500, rate_301_400 AS rate301To400, rate_300_or_below AS rate300OrBelow, average_rate AS averageRate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM credit_loan_rate_option WHERE catalog_product_id = #{catalogProductId} ORDER BY rate_category_code, credit_loan_rate_option_id
